title: Lobu, Tampias Language (LOW)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Tampias Lobu is an endangered indigenous language of Malaysia. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by a decreasing number of young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.
